nodes.description: a comparison of a candidate with the baseline on the design's metrics; its result is candidate_better or baseline_better
nodes.name: comparison

nodes.description: a review of an experiment design; its result is passed or failed
nodes.name: design_review

nodes.description: a check of the runs behind a set of results for leakage, contamination or other integrity violations; its result is clean or violated
nodes.name: integrity_check

nodes.description: a rerun on the same dataset snapshot and run configuration; its result is matched or diverged
nodes.name: reproduction

nodes.description: a sweep of a candidate's effect over seeds or ablations; its result is stable or unstable
nodes.name: seed_sweep

nodes.description: a comparison of the current candidate revision found it better than the baseline
nodes.name: candidate.beats_baseline

nodes.description: a seed sweep of the current candidate revision found its effect stable
nodes.name: effect.robust

nodes.description: the current experiment design passed review and the current results carry no integrity violation
nodes.name: experiment.valid

nodes.description: the experiment is valid, its result reproducible, and the candidate beats the baseline with a robust effect
nodes.name: hypothesis.supported

nodes.description: a reproduction of the current results matched them
nodes.name: result.reproducible

nodes.description: the case closed on an explicit decision that the experiment settles nothing
nodes.name: inconclusive

nodes.description: the case closed because the experiment itself is not valid
nodes.name: invalid_experiment

nodes.description: the case closed with the hypothesis refuted; needs a valid experiment and a reproducible result in which the candidate does not beat the baseline. A comparison that is missing, or about another candidate revision, refutes nothing: it leaves the comparison unknown, not false
nodes.name: refuted

nodes.description: the case closed because another case explicitly superseded it
nodes.name: superseded

nodes.description: the case closed with the hypothesis supported
nodes.name: supported

protocol.description: Test a hypothesis by experiment: run a candidate against a baseline on a frozen dataset snapshot under a reviewed design, and close the case supported when the experiment is valid and its result reproducible, beats the baseline and is robust; refuted when a valid, reproducible result does not beat the baseline; invalid when the experiment itself is not valid; or inconclusive or superseded on an explicit decision.
